Daniele Goldoni, post-doctoral researcher at OptoLAB, has received the **Premio di Dottorato di Ricerca "C. Offelli" 2026**, the award that GMEE (Gruppo Misure Elettriche ed Elettroniche) gives to the best Italian PhD thesis in electrical and electronic measurements. The award was presented on 8 September 2026 at the **Forum Nazionale delle Misure**, held at Università Mediterranea di Reggio Calabria on 7-9 September 2026.

The award recognizes his doctoral thesis, *Emerging Environmental and Biomedical Applications of Advanced Integrated Nanoelectrode Array Sensing Platform*.
